articles.title: Bows and old guns: Indigenous militias left to fight Peru’s cocaine gangs alone
articles.summary:
Decades after Lima armed them to fight Shining Path rebels, the Asháninka are still defending their Amazon rainforest, but now against drug traffickers – and without any help

Shielding his eyes from the tropical sun, Irmeo Sánchez Gómez – better known by his nom de guerre, Kiri – pointed up at a weathered shed on top of a hill, a few frayed sandbags piled at its base. Beyond it, the Tambo River snaked through Peru’s Amazonian rainforest.

“When the terrorists came,” Kiri says, “they would shoot up at us from the riverbank. Without guns of our own, we defended ourselves with bows and arrows. Later, the army gave us guns and built these defences.”

Pesticides sold by European chemical companies were named in more than 1,600 poisoning reports in Brazil last year, an investigation has found.

About a third of the cases involved chemicals banned from use on farms in the EU because of the risks they pose to people and the environment. But European companies are not banned from manufacturing these chemicals, as long as they export them overseas to countries where they are legally allowed to be used.

articles.title: Guatemala Profile
articles.summary:
Guatemala Profile

Guatemala's criminal organizations are among the most sophisticated and dangerous in Central America. Some of them have been in operation for decades. They include former members of the military, intelligence agencies and active members of the police. Transporting illegal drugs north comprises the bulk of their activity, but organized crime in Guatemala is also involved in marijuana and poppy cultivation, as well as human trafficking, kidnapping, extortion, money laundering, arms smuggling, adoption rings, eco trafficking and other illegal enterprises. They often work with groups from Mexico, Colombia and other Central American nations and they have the potential to expand and command other Central American nations' underworlds. Read more

articles.title: November 17 blackout hoax: How a conspiracy theory went viral around the world
articles.summary: A conspiracy theory claiming a worldwide "blackout" will hit the world on November 17 has spread across social media, with the claim it will cut electricity, internet and banking services. The rumour stems from a routine US FEMA emergency alert test, but was amplified by cryptocurrency accounts, misleading claims about EU preparedness advice and references to "The Simpsons". Recent technology outages, flight disruptions and cyberattacks have added to public anxiety, helping turn a routine test into a global hoax.

Economic stability is being impacted by fluctuating commodity prices, particularly coffee and oil, and strained trade relations with the US.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává pokračující vyjednávání o americko-argentinské obchodní dohodě a reakce trhů na politický vývoj v Brazílii a Peru.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, ongoing negotiations regarding the US-Argentina trade deal and market reactions to political developments in Brazil and Peru are expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Jižní čelí rostoucímu napětí z organizovaného zločinu a politických střetů, zejména v Chile, kde protesty kvůli cenám pohonných hmot zatěžují vládu prezidenta Kasta. Zatímco Brazílie se potýká s politickým bojem v Senátu ovládaném pravicovou opozicí, Argentina usiluje o urychlení obchodní dohody s USA navzdory neshodám vládních představitelů.
archive.security_status_en: South America faces mounting pressure from organized crime and political strife, notably in Chile where fuel price protests strain President Kast's administration. While Brazil grapples with legislative gridlock as the right consolidates power in the Senate, Argentina seeks to fast-track a US trade deal amid internal political frictions.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává posun v obchodních jednáních mezi USA a Argentinou a odezva trhů na protivládní protesty v Chile spojené s cenami pohonných hmot.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, attention will focus on progress in US-Argentina trade talks and market reactions to anti-government fuel price protests in Chile.

archive.security_status_cs: Jižní čelí rostoucímu napětí kvůli protivládním protestům a dopravním stávkám v Chile vyvolaným cenami pohonných hmot a stupňujícím se útokům organizovaného zločinu na úředníky. Paraguay mezitím řeší hlubokou politickou krizi po kolapsu Ueno Bank, zatímco v Brazílii se pravicová opozice snaží konsolidovat moc v Senátu navzdory volební porážce.
archive.security_status_en: South America faces mounting tension driven by anti-government protests and transport strikes in Chile over fuel prices, alongside escalating organized crime attacks targeting public officials. Meanwhile, Paraguay is grappling with a deep political crisis following the collapse of Ueno Bank, while in Brazil the right-wing opposition seeks to consolidate power in the Senate despite its recent presidential defeat.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává další politický manévr ohledně projednávání argentinské obchodní dohody v Kongresu a sledování dopadů protestů na chilskou ekonomiku.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, attention will focus on political maneuvering regarding the Argentine trade deal in Congress and monitoring the economic impact of ongoing protests in Chile.

archive.security_status_cs: Jižní Amerika čelí napětí v důsledku politických třenic v Brazílii, kde pravicová opozice upevňuje pozice v Senátu, a rostoucích sociálních protestů v Chile kvůli cenám pohonných hmot. Paraguay mezitím řeší otřes důvěry investorů po bankovním skandálu spojeném s exprezidentem Peňou.
archive.security_status_en: South America faces heightened tension due to political friction in Brazil, where the right-wing opposition is consolidating its Senate presence, and rising social protests in Chile over fuel prices. Meanwhile, Paraguay is dealing with a shaken investor confidence following a banking scandal linked to ex-president Peña.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává sledování politických vyjednávání v brazilském Senátu, dopadů chilských protestů na dopravu a vývoje v Paraguayi po bankovním skandálu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, attention will focus on political negotiations in the Brazilian Senate, the impact of Chilean protests on transport, and developments in Paraguay following the banking scandal.

archive.security_status_cs: Jižní Amerika se potýká s přetrvávajícími bezpečnostními riziky spojenými s narkokartely v Andském regionu, zatímco v Brazílii sílí politické napětí kolem pravicové opozice v Senátu po nedávných volbách. Ekonomická stabilita regionu je podpořena rostoucím argentinským energetickým sektorem a diplomatickou stabilitou v rámci Mercosuru.
archive.security_status_en: South America faces persistent security risks tied to drug cartels in the Andean region, while political tensions grow in Brazil around the right-wing opposition in the Senate following recent elections. Regional economic stability is supported by Argentina's booming energy sector and diplomatic stability within Mercosur.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává sledování politických manévrů v brazilském Senátu a reakcí trhů na vývoj v argentinském energetickém sektoru.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, attention will focus on political maneuvers in the Brazilian Senate and market reactions to developments in Argentina's energy sector.
